name: csi300_h5_vs_h1
description: Alpha158, Qlib default processing (raw features, z-scored label), Qlib LightGBM parameters, TopkDropout top-50 n_drop 5. Challenger trains on the 5-day forward return (Ref($close,-6)/Ref($close,-1)-1), incumbent on the 1-day return; both predict and trade daily. Three seeds, per-day percentile ranks averaged, ties broken by the stable key.
development_evidence: Pooled walk-forward 2018-2025, 4 tie draws: CSI300 IR 1.26 -> 1.52 (paired NW t 0.72), CSI500 0.45 -> 0.90 (t 1.29), CSI1000 -0.13 -> 0.93 (t 4.12); day-averaged across the three universes t 3.0 at NW 7/20/60, dIR +0.78 (90% CI 0.35-1.24). CSI500/CSI1000 fits were made after the CSI300 result with the hypothesis fixed. Files: book_wf_horizon.json, book_csi500_horizon.json, book_csi1000_horizon.json.
rule: Score both books with book_eval.py --window live=... from the first session after provider_last_date. Decide at 2027-10-15 (about 240 sessions): the challenger is confirmed if its paired daily after-cost excess over the incumbent has NW(20) t > 0 and the live IR of h5 is not below h1 by more than 0.5; a paired t below -2 refutes it. No other book, parameter or window may be consulted for this decision.

live_validation_2024-10_to_2026-09.note: Three-seed books of the live fits scored on their own validation segment (from cash, 2 tie keys). The most recent two years on CSI300 favour the 1-day label, as wf2024 did; the development evidence for h5 is pooled across 2018-2025 and three universes. Recorded before freezing so the holdout's prior is explicit.
